subject: POC kickoff recap \u0014 ACME / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>, Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff recap  ACME / next steps

Hi Samir / Dana 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. If anything below looks off, please flag and Ill update.

Pain points we heard
- System latency on customer-facing search responses (current 8001,200ms p95) causing drop-off on mobile
- Cost per query is high when running the current Transformer-based reranker at scale
- Limited ability to A/B test model changes without impacting production traffic

POC goals / success metrics (30-day POC)
- Latency: reduce p95 to <= 250ms for 1k RPS synthetic workload
- Cost: target 40% lower cost per 1k queries versus current baseline (your perf numbers v sent)
- Quality: maintain current NDCG within 2% of baseline on the provided eval set

Scope of work
- Redwood will deploy a dedicated POC instance (shared test cluster) pinned to model v1.2.
- We will run two evaluation suites: your customer-search prompt set (attached) + a synthetic load test.
- Integration: ACME provides sample dataset (anonymized) + temporary API key for test account.

Owners / roles
- ACME: Samir (technical lead)  provide sample data + environment credentials; Dana (product owner)  define acceptance criteria
- Redwood: Marissa (AE, program owner)  POC schedule / stakeholder communication; Rishi (SRE)  infra + throughput tuning; Neha (solutions)  prompt engineering + eval tracking; Alex (CS)  rollout guidance

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope & access  share sample dataset + test account
- Week 1: infra setup & model provisioning (Rishi)
- Week 2: prompt set runs + baseline evals (Neha)
- Week 3: tuning and performance runs; cost analysis (Rishi/Neha)
- Week 4: wrap-up + final readout; decision on expansion / dedicated capacity

Access / initial setup items we need from ACME
1) Anonymized sample dataset (S3 link or zipped CSV)  recommended: 10k records representative of production
2) Test API key / sandbox account with basic query endpoint access
3) A security contact for quick questionnaire items (SOC 2 artifact requests may come up)

Attachments
- acme_poc_scope.pdf (POC scope & success metrics)
- sample_prompt_set.csv (small set of prompts we'll run for evals)

Next steps
- Samir / Dana: confirm timeline and share sample dataset + account details by EOD Tue (27 Apr)
- Redwood: well schedule the infra kickoff meeting for Wed (28 Apr) and share calendar invite

Thanks  looking forward to getting started.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
